input.summary: Insert Contractor indemnity (third-party IP, breach of law, data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) as new Section 7(d), carved out of the 7(a) cap, and conform the Section 7 heading.
input.comment: [Playbook] The agreement contains no Contractor indemnity at all — Section 7 is caps only, despite its heading — so we have added a standard Contractor indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and wilful misconduct, with usual notice and control procedure. Our playbook treats a vendor IP indemnity as a required protection given the IP warranty already in Section 5(c); we can discuss a super-cap on these obligations instead of an uncapped carve-out if that helps.

ops.oldText: 7. LIMITATIONS OF LIABILITY; INDEMNIFICATION OF CONTRACTOR.

ops.text: (d) Contractor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, losses, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Services or the Works infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (ii) Contractor's breach of any applicable law, rule or regulation; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Company's Confidential Information or data caused by Contractor; or (iv) Contractor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Company shall give Contractor prompt written notice of the claim, and Contractor shall have control of the defense and settlement of the claim (provided that no settlement imposing any obligation or admission on Company shall be made without Company's prior written consent), with Company's reasonable cooperation at Contractor's expense. Contractor's obligations under this Section 7(d), and Company's recovery in respect of them, shall not be subject to the limitation of liability in Section 7(a). Company shall indemnify Contractor only against third-party claims to the extent arising out of materials or content furnished by Company to Contractor or Company's breach of applicable law.
